To uninstall cmatrix, you can use the following methods depending on your operating system.

If you're on a Debian-based system like Ubuntu, you can use the following command in your terminal:

```
sudo apt-get remove cmatrix
```

If you're on a Red Hat-based system like Fedora, you can use the following command in your terminal:

```
sudo dnf remove cmatrix
```

If you're on a system that uses a package manager like Homebrew, you can use the following command in your terminal:

```
brew remove cmatrix
```

If you installed cmatrix manually, you can simply delete the executable file from your system. The location of the executable file may vary depending on your system configuration.

After uninstalling cmatrix, you can also remove any configuration files that were created during the installation process. The location of these configuration files may also vary depending on your system configuration.
